package.name: riptide_mujoco
package.description: MuJoCo simulation seam: a hardware_interface::SystemInterface (riptide_mujoco/MujocoSystem) that embeds MuJoCo, reads joint state, writes joint torques and steps the physics in the controller_manager update loop. Requires a MuJoCo SDK (headers + libmujoco); see CMakeLists MUJOCO_ROOT.
